name: UI Automation Actor
purpose: Perform ONE UI Automation control-pattern action (invoke/toggle/select/expand/collapse/setvalue/focus) on a single element located by automation id, name, control type, and/or child-path from uia.inspector. Acting half of UIA, kept separate from inspection. UIA patterns only — no synthetic mouse/keyboard. Supports a dry-run/-WhatIf preview.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -Hwnd <int> | -ProcessId <int> | -Title <glob> (else the desktop root); -Action <invoke|toggle|select|expand|collapse|setvalue|focus>; locators -AutomationId <exact> -Name <glob> -ControlType <exact> -Path <child-index path>; -Value <string> (setvalue); -DryRun/-WhatIf; -Depth <int> -MaxElements <int>. OR -InputsJson '<json {hwnd,pid,title,action,automation_id,name,control_type,path,value,dry_run,depth,max_elements}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: pid
inputs.description: Target by process id (uses its main window).

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: invoke | toggle | select | expand | collapse | setvalue | focus.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Locator: glob match on element Name.

inputs.name: control_type
inputs.description: Locator: exact control type (e.g. Button, CheckBox, Edit).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Locator: child-index path from uia.inspector (authoritative when supplied; empty string = the target itself).

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to set for action=setvalue (required for a real setvalue).

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Resolve and report the intended action without performing it (also -WhatIf).

inputs.name: depth
inputs.description: Max search depth when resolving by property locators (ignored when path is supplied).

outputs.description: { target, action, dry_run, performed, actionable, requested_pattern, pattern_supported, locator, resolved_element, candidate_count, candidates[], before_state, after_state, blockers[] }
